Name: Shannon Tuley
Badge: Reading to Write: Say-Mean-Matter
How might you introduce Say-Mean-Matter to your students? What about this framework do you think will be helpful for them? What might be challenging?:

As an introduction to this activity, I think it would be helpful to present it as a bell ringer or a way to start class. I think it would be helpful to start with a motivational/inspirational quote to get them used the this routine. I think this framework would be helpful for my students because it gets them thinking about a quote or text on a deeper level. I love how it creates a connection between what the text is saying and something relevant to the student. I also really like this activity for teaching theme using evidence from the text. I think it's a great way for them to use what a character or narrator says and apply it to a moral or lesson (why does it matter = theme). It might be challenging for students to use a longer text for this, but annotating can help with that.

Upload an example you’ve created to try out They Say/I Say or Say-Mean-Matter with your students. This could be a handout or chart, a text plus directions for guiding students through the process, or a sample notebook/annotation page that models how the routine might look in practice.:
